color.note: Mostly paper and ink. All values are OKLCH. Mint and Pop share lightness and chroma (0.86 / 0.14); Lemon sits higher (0.91 / 0.17) because yellow only reads clean near the top of the lightness range. Proportion on a typical screen: Air 70, Ink 20, Mint 6, Lemon 3, Pop 1.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: Brand paper. The light page background (via `bg`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand ink. Light-mode text and primary buttons; code blocks and toasts in both modes. AAA on `air`, `lemon` and `mint`.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand, agents, success: the logo pill, agent badges, the secondary button, the toast check. Text on it is `ink` or `pine`, never white.

tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: The highlight, and people: `.hl`, person badges, dark-mode primary buttons. Text on it is `ink` or `pine`, never white.

tokens.name: pop
tokens.usage: Warnings, expiry, destructive: the destructive button and the error toast mark. Never decoration.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: The dark-mode background (via `bg`), and the ink inside a highlight on dark grounds.

tokens.name: mark-dot
tokens.usage: The full stop after the short mark on Air. On Pine the dot goes `lemon`; on Lemon or Mint grounds it goes `ink`.

tokens.name: mint-50
tokens.usage: Mint tint: agent-tinted panels, the Team badge ground.

tokens.name: mint-200
tokens.usage: Mint soft: the 4px focus halo (`focus-ring`).

tokens.name: mint-400
tokens.usage: Mint base; an alias of `mint`.

tokens.name: mint-700
tokens.usage: Mint as text or a mark on `air` or `surface` (AA); the on state of a switch.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Badge text on `mint-50`; the Do column head in voice tables.

tokens.name: lemon-50
tokens.usage: Lemon tint: the copy-field ground, the Anyone-with-link badge ground, voice cards.

tokens.name: lemon-200
tokens.usage: Lemon soft: the underline marker under a text link at rest.

tokens.name: lemon-400
tokens.usage: Lemon base; an alias of `lemon`.

tokens.name: lemon-700
tokens.usage: Lemon as a mark on `ink`: the underline under Retry in an error toast.

tokens.name: lemon-ink
tokens.usage: Badge text on `lemon-50`.

tokens.name: pop-50
tokens.usage: Pop tint: a destructive-confirmation panel ground.

tokens.name: pop-200
tokens.usage: Pop soft: the error halo on an input (`error-ring`) and the Expires badge ground.

tokens.name: pop-400
tokens.usage: Pop base; an alias of `pop`.

tokens.name: pop-700
tokens.usage: Error text and the error input border on `surface`; the Don't column head.

tokens.name: pop-ink
tokens.usage: Badge text on `pop-200`.

tokens.name: toast-info
tokens.usage: The info toast's mark: a quiet circle on `ink`, for news that’s neither a success nor a failure.

tokens.name: on-toast-info
tokens.usage: The lowercase i on `toast-info`.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Air in light, Pine in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs and the answer viewer frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, disabled fills; in dark mode the secondary button and the Private badge.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet section grounds (logo clear-space panels, toast showcase) and the hovered table row. Light mode only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table rules, the header rule. Decorative; a control's edge is `control-line`.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: The sticky header's bottom rule, a step lighter than `line`.

tokens.name: control-line
tokens.usage: Quiet-button and input borders at rest; the off track of a switch.

tokens.name: check-line
tokens.usage: Unchecked checkbox and radio borders.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata and column heads on `bg` and `surface` (AA).

tokens.name: body-text
tokens.usage: Long-form body and lede copy on `bg` and `surface`. The Bible gives no separate dark value, so dark uses `text-muted`.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on `surface`.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Label of a disabled control on `surface-raised` or `line`. Below 4.5:1 by design (WCAG exempts disabled controls).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill. Ink in light, Lemon in dark.

tokens.name: on-action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button label on `action-primary`.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill in light mode.

tokens.name: action-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill. Mint in light; a raised Pine surface in dark so Mint stays reserved for agents and the logo.

tokens.name: action-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary button hover fill in light mode.

tokens.name: action-destructive-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover fill; at rest it is `pop`.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code block and terminal ground, both modes.

tokens.name: code-text
tokens.usage: Text on `code-bg`; the prompt glyph is `mint`.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Comments and the Copy action on `code-bg`.

tokens.name: stripe-a
tokens.usage: Answer thumbnail placeholder stripe, light band.

tokens.name: stripe-b
tokens.usage: Answer thumbnail placeholder stripe, dark band.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Gabarito, 700 and 800 only. Tight tracking, always sentence case.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One hero line per page at most.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Figtree: UI, body, labels. 400, 500, 600. Never below 12px. Measure 60–72 characters; body caps at about 640px; text-wrap: pretty.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Send HTML, CSS and JS from your agent. Get back a private link in under a second.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Answers stay private until you share them. You can revoke a link at any time.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, table heads, metadata labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps and fine print; the smallest size.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Mono means copyable: code, commands, URLs, tokens and IDs. If a reader can't paste it somewhere, it isn't mono.

spacing.note: A 4px base grid. Prefer space over lines to separate things; use a line only when space alone is ambiguous.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, badge insets.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons; toast gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small cards; grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section internals; the marketing outer margin.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between groups on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: 12 for controls, 16 for cards, 20 for panels and dialogs. Pills for badges, chips and the logo only.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, grid swatches.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Small buttons, the segmented-control thumb, the Copy button inside a copy field.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, code blocks, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and answer cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, the answer-viewer preview.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, switches and the logo pill only.

shadow.note: Three elevations: 0 Flat (cards, rows: a `line` border, no shadow), 1 Lifted, 2 Floating. Halos mark focus and error.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Lifted: the active segment or tab.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Floating: dialogs and the answer-viewer preview.

tokens.name: shadow-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, on their `ink` ground.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The white knob of an off switch.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Focus halo on inputs and hover halo on primary buttons: 4px of `mint-200` outside the border, which turns `ink` on an input.

tokens.name: error-ring
tokens.usage: Error halo on an input: 4px of `pop-200` outside a `pop-700` border.

size.note: Every control is at least 40px tall on desktop and 44px on touch.

tokens.name: control-md

tokens.name: control-lg

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum control height on touch.

tokens.usage: Icons in dense UI.

tokens.name: icon
